links.outcome: Self-preference bias of LLM judges when scoring HealthBench medical chat rubrics
links.effect: SPB skews model scores by up to 10 points on HealthBench; judges can be over 50% more likely to wrongly mark failed rubrics as satisfied for their own outputs on IFEval and LiveCodeBench.
links.quote: On HealthBench, a medical chat benchmark with subjective rubrics, we observe that SPB skews model scores by up to 10 points, a potentially decisive margin when ranking frontier models.

unlisted_practices: Ensembling multiple LLM judges to mitigate self-preference bias in LLM-as-a-judge evaluation

screen.reason: Evaluates self-preference bias in automated rubric-based evaluation (LLM-as-a-judge) across benchmarks including HealthBench, and tests judge ensembling as a mitigation practice.

primary.practice: judge ensembling for automated LLM evaluation
